description: Nightly charge for a security patrol contract; the first message does not say how many visits a night the site takes. DISTILL-CANARY-5b16da4f

files.README.md:
# Woldstone Security - patrol contracts

Patrol contracts are priced per night from the number of visits a site takes.
The office quotes from the rate card below, and a site joins the round when its
contract starts.

turns.prompt: The yard at Cairnmuir Business Park is going on the round from next month and the agent has asked what it will cost them. What is the nightly figure we quote for that site?
They want four visits a night. What is the nightly figure for four visits? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
